description: Implementation of QuicCryptoClientConfig class handling QUIC client cryptographic configuration, including server config caching, key exchange, and handshake message processing.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Manages QUIC client cryptographic configuration, including server config caching, key exchange, and handshake message processing.

classes.name: CachedState
classes.description: Represents cached server configuration state, including server config data, proof, expiration, and validation status.

methods.name: InitializeFrom
methods.description: Initializes cached state from another cached state, typically from a canonical configuration.

methods.name: AddCanonicalSuffix
methods.description: Adds a suffix to match hostnames for canonical configuration.

methods.name: PopulateFromCanonicalConfig
methods.description: Populates cached state from a canonical configuration if hostname matches suffixes.

methods.name: FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Fills a handshake message with initial client hello parameters.

methods.name: FillClientHello
methods.description: Constructs a complete client hello message based on cached state and parameters.

methods.name: CacheNewServerConfig
methods.description: Caches a new server configuration from a handshake message.

methods.name: ProcessRejection
methods.description: Processes a server rejection message and updates cached state accordingly.

methods.name: ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes a server hello message and derives session keys.

methods.name: ProcessServerConfigUpdate
